answer: The knoll counter is kept in comet and river shows each reset. Someone thus has to keep every sock puppet continuously active for 28 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 28 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 1211 identities would post 540 proofs and burn roughly 48 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
